description: This file contains utility functions and interfaces for handling expectations and matchers in testing, including serialization of expected values, formatting matcher messages, and colorized output helpers.

methods.name: serializeExpectedTextValues
methods.description: Serializes an array of strings or RegExp objects into ExpectedTextValue objects with optional matching options.

methods.name: formatMatcherMessage
methods.description: Formats a detailed message for test matcher failures, including expected/received values, diffs, and logs.

methods.name: callLogText
methods.description: Generates a formatted string of call logs if available.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedSubstring
methods.description: Highlights a substring within a received string for display in test output.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedResult
methods.description: Formats the result of a regex match against a received string.

methods.name: printValue
methods.description: Converts a value to a JSON string or fallback string.

methods.name: printReceived
methods.description: Colors and formats a received value for output.

methods.name: printExpected
methods.description: Colors and formats an expected value for output.
